headline: Heat breaks Saturday — harvest onions, potatoes, dry beans.
weather_notes: Restrict all outdoor work to before 9 AM through Friday — Heat Advisory active at 100–101°F closes every afternoon window.
Plan all harvesting for Saturday morning before 10 AM — Heat Advisory lifts at 7 AM Saturday with 95°F high, the week's best work window.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM daily through Friday — 100–101°F puts Phoenix and Hamson fruit at sunscald risk with harvest windows opening Aug 24.
Pull w4 onions Saturday morning before any afternoon storms — 30–50% storm chance Saturday afternoon complicates curing if bulbs remain in wet ground.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 41 days overdue — Saturday morning after the Heat Advisory lifts at 7 AM is the first comfortable outdoor cane-work window in weeks.

suggested_tasks.title: Pull w4 onions — 117 days, past maturity
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 117 days are deep past their maturity window — pull Saturday morning before afternoon storm risk saturates soil and complicates curing.

suggested_tasks.title: Dig potato bags — 13 days past harvest window
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 93 days is 13 past the 80-day outer window — dig Saturday morning while the Heat Advisory is lifted and conditions are most workable.

suggested_tasks.title: Harvest c1 dry beans — pods should be papery
suggested_tasks.description: Good Mother Stollard at 109 days is well past its 85–90-day dry window — pull pods Saturday before pod shatter accelerates under 100°F+ heat.

suggested_tasks.title: Check e1 Phoenix for fruit showing color
suggested_tasks.description: Harvest window opens Aug 24 — inspect Sunday for any fruit advancing early, as sustained 100°F+ can accelerate ripening ahead of schedule.
